jobs.title: Project Manager - Professional Services
jobs.description:
**Help Us Change the Way People Use Technology**
------------------------------------------------


At DGR Systems, we’re about connecting companies to the right solutions and enabling them to gain the most value from their investments. We go to great lengths to hire great people because, at our core, our clients deserve to have each person working on their project bring qualified expertise, a can\-do attitude, and experience\-based strategic insights to the table. They need to trust their IT consulting firm as a partner who is there to help accelerate their success and not pass them off to a junior team after the contract has been signed. Want to join us?

 **THE ROLE**


DGR Systems designs and delivers technology solutions that our clients rely on to run their organizations. Behind every project sits a technical team doing complex, specialized work at high standards, and a client who is counting on us to deliver what we committed to.
This role is about more than coordinating tasks. You will own the client relationship, the project record, and the path forward on every engagement you touch, from kickoff through close.
You will report to the Sr. Manager, PMO and work closely with DGR's Technical Leads in a two\-in\-the\-box delivery model.
The Project Manager and Technical Lead bring different responsibilities to the engagement but share accountability for delivering a successful outcome.**WHY THIS ISN’T A STANDARD BOOKKEEPING JOB**


This role will feel different from a PM position where every project follows the same playbook. DGR has established delivery methodologies, standards, and support structures, but our engagements vary significantly in size, complexity, technology, and client environment.
A network refresh spanning more than a thousand sites requires a different approach than an identity modernization for a healthcare system or a security framework deployment for a government organization. We expect our PMs to understand the difference and adjust the level of planning, communication, and governance accordingly. You will work with a Technical Lead who understands the technical work, established delivery methodologies to guide the engagement, and the flexibility to adapt the approach together based on what the project requires.
The PM's role is not to direct the technical team. It is to create the conditions for the technical team to do their best work while keeping the client informed, expectations aligned, and the engagement moving forward.**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**


This role covers two things that have to work together for any engagement to succeed. **The Project*** Lead technology projects end to end, applying DGR's delivery methodologies to fit the engagement rather than the other way around
* Partner with the assigned Technical Lead in a two\-in\-the\-box model, sharing ownership of the outcome and making sure priorities, decisions, dependencies, and next steps remain clear.
* Own all project documentation, artifacts, and reporting. The client, leadership, and team should always have an accurate read on where things stand.
* Anticipate and clear roadblocks ahead of the team rather than reacting after they have slowed delivery
* Surface risks and dependencies early, along with a recommendation for how to address them.
* Match the level of process and coordination to what each engagement actually needs. Apply the right level of structure for the size, complexity, and risk of the engagement.

 **The Client Relationship*** Be the client's primary contact. Own the relationship through proactive communication, honest status, and expectations that match reality.
* Manage scope clearly and professionally. Help clients understand what is included, identify when a request represents a change, and work through those conversations without losing trust.
* Coordinate across internal teams, partners, and client stakeholders to keep everyone aligned and moving forward.

  

You will also keep project records and documentation current throughout each engagement, not as a milestone activity but as an ongoing standard. We treat that as part of the job, not as something to get to later.**HOW WE WORK**

* **We match the level of process to the engagement.** Complex or sensitive projects require more structure, while smaller, focused engagements may need less. Strong PMs here know how to recognize the difference**.**
* **The Technical Lead is your delivery partner.** You are not expected to manage their technical work. You are expected to work alongside them to keep the engagement organized, remove obstacles, manage the client experience, and make sure the team is moving toward the same outcome.
* **Proactive communication matters, especially when the news is difficult.** We expect clients to hear about risks, delays, or changes from us early, along with a clear explanation of what happens next.
* **The project record** **stays** **current.** Every engagement should be in good enough shape that another PM could pick it up tomorrow without asking you for context. That is the standard that protects the client and protects DGR.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**You'll** **Need*** 3 or more years of project management experience in technology consulting or professional services
* A track record of managing IT deployments, integrations, and migrations across infrastructure, networking, security, or modern workplace environments
* Experience navigating difficult client conversations, including scope changes, competing expectations, project risk, or delivery challenges.
* A proactive communication style, especially when a project is at risk or expectations need to be reset.
* Strong project documentation habits, with the ability to maintain a clear and accurate project record throughout the engagement.

 **It Will Help If You Have*** Worked across multiple technology service areas
* Experience with a delivery model where a PM and technical lead share ownership of the outcome
* Exposure to Microsoft technolo

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and oversee complex construction projects from inception to completion. This pivotal role demands a proactive leader who excels in managing teams, coordinating schedules, and ensuring projects adhere to quality, safety, and regulatory standards. As a Senior Project Manager, you will drive project success by leveraging your expertise in construction management software, cost control, and technical planning. Your energetic approach will inspire teams and stakeholders alike to achieve outstanding results on time and within budget. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated professional eager to make a significant impact on large\-scale infrastructure projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of construction projects, ensuring alignment with client specifications, budgets, and timelines.
* Manage project schedules using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar project management software to coordinate all phases of construction activities.
* Oversee the development and review of construction plans, schematics, blueprints, and technical drawings using Civil 3D and Bluebeam.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure seamless project flow and compliance with construction regulations.
* Monitor project budgets meticulously through HeavyBid or comparable cost management tools; implement strategies for cost control and risk mitigation.
* Supervise construction site activities, ensuring adherence to safety standards, regulatory compliance, and quality assurance protocols.
* Manage contract negotiations and administration using ProCore or Prolog to track progress, change orders, and documentation.
* Lead project teams by assigning tasks effectively, managing time efficiently, and fostering a collaborative environment focused on high performance.
* Conduct regular site inspections to verify progress against plans and resolve issues promptly; read schematics and blueprints accurately for precise implementation.
* Ensure all construction activities meet local codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards while maintaining open communication with stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience managing large\-scale infrastructure or commercial construction projects; civil or structural engineering background preferred.
* Extensive knowledge of construction management software such as ProCore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Prolog, HeavyBid, and other project scheduling tools.
* Strong understanding of construction estimating, cost management strategies, contract administration, and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to manage teams in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high standards of safety and quality.
* Skilled in reading blueprints, schematics, and technical drawings; proficient in blueprint reading and schematic interpretation.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively within tight deadlines.
* Construction site experience combined with knowledge of construction regulations applicable to infrastructure projects.
* Effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse teams including clients, contractors, engineers, and regulatory agencies.

Join us as a Senior Project Manager if you’re passionate about leading impactful construction initiatives! Bring your expertise in project scheduling, team leadership, cost control, and technical planning to deliver exceptional results on some of the most challenging infrastructure projects around the clock!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, GRC
jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the GRC team, you are the organizational partner to Engineering, Product, and UX leaders building complex, customer\-facing software. You are also the connective tissue between technical delivery and the business teams who take it to market: CPX, Solution Consultants, and the go\-to\-market teams who depend on what your programs produce. Where Product owns what gets built and Engineering owns how it gets built, you own whether the organization has what it needs to deliver. That means creating clarity so others can move faster, enabling decisions so leaders can act with confidence, and removing the friction that keeps good teams from doing their best work.


You bring active fluency with AI tools to this work, both in how you operate personally and in how you help GRC think about what AI\-augmented execution requires.


**What you'll do**
------------------

* Continuously assess whether programs are structured to succeed, not just on schedule
* Ask the questions others are not asking, across any function. Read absence as a signal: the update that stopped coming, the risk nobody is naming, the decision that has been deferred longer than it should be
* Drive alignment across Engineering, Product, and UX as conditions change, reconciling divergence before it becomes an execution gap
* Engage in technical conversations with enough fluency to participate credibly: understanding architecture decisions, dependency risk, and sequencing implications
* Identify what is blocking forward progress and choose the right lever to remove it: facilitation, coordination, or escalation with a clear framing
* Synthesize cross\-functional risks and ensure they reach the right owner with enough time to act
* Name what others are managing around. When a program is at structural risk, say so directly to the people who need to hear it
* Surface recurring friction patterns and drive improvements to how teams plan, coordinate, and execute
* Prepare the organization for ownership transitions before responsibility shifts, not after
* Use AI tools actively as part of how you work: synthesizing information, accelerating communication, and improving quality of shared context to reduce the coordination overhead that comes from manual status\-gathering
* Track how AI\-augmented development changes delivery patterns on your programs and contribute to the TPMO's AI operating model

**What you'll need**
--------------------

Minimum qualifications


* 4\+ years of technical program or project management experience within a software engineering environment
* Bachelor's degree in a technical/STEM field or equivalent professional experience

Preferred qualifications


* Demonstrated experience operating across Engineering, Product, and UX in a multi\-team software organization, with a track record of influencing direction without direct authority
* Active use of AI tools (such as Claude, Copilot, or LLM\-based workflows) as a core part of how you work
* Ability to engage credibly in technical conversations, including architecture, dependencies, and sequencing risk
* Comfortable naming structural risk clearly, even when the message is unwelcome
* Experience facilitating trade\-off decisions and briefing at the director and VP level
* Track record of identifying organizational root causes and driving durable solutions
* Strong written communication; able to synthesize fragmented information into shared understanding
* Experience applying and adapting delivery frameworks; you know when structure helps and when it creates friction
* Understanding of how AI\-augmented development changes how engineering teams plan and execute
* Experience in GRC, compliance, financial reporting, or regulated\-industry software
* Comfortable building structure in ambiguous environments

**Travel Requirements \& Working Conditions**

* Willingness to travel up to 10% for key team and corporate events
* Reliable internet access for remote and flexible work arrangements

**How You’ll Be Rewarded**

✅ Salary range in the US: $111,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00
✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually


✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire


✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package


The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.


**Why Join Workiva**

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI\-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.


At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

ABOUT THE ROLE
  
Pellera is seeking a strategic, creative, and results\-oriented Content Marketing Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of content that strengthens brand awareness, engages target audiences, and supports business growth.
  
This role will be responsible for telling the Pellera story across every stage of the customer journey, from social media and creative assets to customer success stories, sales enablement assets, thought leadership, and website content. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and storyteller who can translate complex technology concepts into compelling, business\-focused narratives that strengthen our brand, support our sales team, and drive engagement with customers and prospects.
  
Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Solutions, Design, Leadership, customers, and partners, this individual will help build and scale a modern content engine that drives engagement, supports lead generation, and strengthens Pellera's market position.

Content Strategy \& Brand Storytelling

* Create and manage high\-quality content including:
* Website copy
* Blogs and articles
* Customer success stories and case studies
* Executive thought leadership
* Email campaigns and newsletters
* Landing pages
* Campaign assets
* Sales enablement materials
* Translate complex technology topics into engaging, business\-focused content.
* Maintain consistent brand messaging, positioning, and voice across all channels.
* Interview and collaborate with customers, executives, technical experts, and partners to uncover stories that highlight business outcomes and innovation.
* Review and edit content to ensure quality, brand consistency, accuracy, and clarity.

* Own Pellera's social media strategy and execution, with primary responsibility for LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Develop platform\-specific content that increases brand awareness, engagement, and thought leadership.
* Partner with designers, videographers, and marketing team members to create compelling visual and written content.
* Repurpose and distribute content across channels to maximize reach and impact.
* Amplify company news, customer success stories, industry insights, executive perspectives, events, and campaign content.
* Monitor channel performance and continuously optimize content based on engagement and business outcomes.


Sales Enablement \& Campaign Support

* Solution briefs
* One\-pagers
* Presentations
* Battlecards
* Playbooks
* Customer proof points
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Solutions teams to support business objectives and buyer journeys.
* Contribute content and messaging for integrated marketing campaigns.

Performance Optimization \& Growth
  
* Apply SEO best practices across website, blog, and landing page content.
* Monitor content performance, social media engagement, and campaign effectiveness using analytics tools.
* Use insights and data to optimize content strategy and improve business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen Pellera's market presence, storytelling approach, and content operations.
* Ensure content initiatives remain aligned with broader marketing and business objectives.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in content marketing, communications, copywriting, journalism, public relations, or a related discipline.
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling capabilities.
* Experience creating content for B2B audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts into clear, compelling customer\-focused narratives.
* Experience developing content across multiple formats, including web, social, email, blog, and sales enablement materials.
* Hands\-on experience executing social media programs across multiple channels.
* Solid understanding of content strategy, SEO principles, and audience engagement.
* Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with marketing, sales, technical, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining brand quality and consistency.
* Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and alignment with company values.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
* 4\+ years of experience within B2B technology organizations.
* Background in IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, AI, or enterprise technology.
* Experience building customer advocacy, customer storytelling, or case study programs.

* Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns.
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, WordPress, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, LinkedIn advertising, Meta platforms, or similar marketing technologies.

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.

At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.

* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.

**Part\-Time; 1099 Contractor**

**Term: October 1, 2026 \- September 1, 2027**

**Aligned Global Network (AGN)** is seeking a highly organized, tech\-savvy, and resourceful **Project Coordinator / Program Manager** to support client engagements while also contributing to AGN's internal operations, marketing, and business development activities.

This is a **part\-time 1099 contractor position averaging 20 hours per week**, with a flexible schedule. Compensation will be commensurate with experience, demonstrated capabilities, and level of responsibility.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working across multiple projects, can move comfortably between strategy and execution, and is energized by the pace and variety of a growing consulting firm. You should be equally comfortable managing a project tracker, coordinating with a client, preparing a meeting agenda, supporting a marketing campaign, and using AI tools to turn a rough idea into a polished work product.

* Track deliverables and proactively identify upcoming deadlines, dependencies, and potential risks.
* Coordinate activities across AGN consultants, client teams, vendors, and partners.
* Prepare project updates, status reports, presentations, and other client\-facing materials.
* Maintain organized project documentation and shared files.
* Support client onboarding and project kickoff activities.
* Follow up with stakeholders to keep projects moving forward.
* Escalate issues, risks, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
* Understand client priorities and translate them into actionable next steps.
* Help ensure a consistent, responsive, and high\-quality client experience.

**2\. Marketing \& Communications Support**

* Support client program marketing campaigns, including client coordination and scheduling of social media and digital content.
* Assist with newsletters, email campaigns, announcements, and client communications.
* Help maintain marketing calendars.
* Coordinate with AGN marketing advisors and creative content developers.
* Help track campaign activity and engagement.
* Conduct outreach and research to identify relevant industry trends, audiences, partners, and opportunities.

**3\. Administration**

Provide general operational support in the following areas:

* Support contractor coordination and administrative workflows as needed.
* Organize meetings and internal team communications.
* Support general administrative needs associated with a growing consulting practice.
* Prepare meeting briefs and research for business development conversations.

AGN is committed to using technology and AI ethically and responsibly to increase efficiency, quality, and capacity. The ideal candidate should be comfortable using AI as a working tool, with **proficiency with Claude/Claude Cowork and/or OpenAI/ChatGPT is strongly preferred.**

Responsibilities may include:

* Use **Claude, ChatGPT/OpenAI, and other AI tools** to accelerate research, drafting, analysis, project documentation, communications, and administrative workflows.
* Use AI to organize information, summarize meetings, develop first drafts, analyze documents, and support project planning.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative and project\-management tasks.
* Learn and work comfortably across new technology platforms and software.
* Support CRM, project management, database, marketing, collaboration, and reporting systems.
* Help AGN identify practical technology improvements that increase efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of **project management, technology fluency, strong communication skills, and entrepreneurial initiative.**

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 **About the Role:**


Our CrowdStrike Data Science Machine Learning Operations and Response Team is looking for a Threat Analyst who is both customer\- and team\-focused. This role will include both response and pro\-active aspects. This role will be perfect for anyone who has experience involving detections and/or reverse engineering. The primary responsibility of this role will be to analyze malware and detections by investigating individual customer detection tickets. This team is focused on improving detection capability and efficiency through analysis of malware or other threat detections impacting our customer base. Experience with detections of potentially malicious behavior by machine learning models is a plus.


Bring your passion for helping internal partners resolve questions about detections of potentially malicious activity by machine learning and our detection capability. Our goal for the team is to both help internal teams respond to customer\-inquiries about threat detection and to provide information about the effects of our detections into the Data Science organization \- including detection efficacy and managing false positive detections.

  

This role will work most closely with internal teams such as Technical Account Managers, Falcon Complete, Data Scientists and the Malware Research Center in Data Science.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Analyze detection data including customer reports to determine which aspects of the machine learning models can be improved
* Perform tasks to enable better\-management of false positive detections
* Analyze binary files to determine their legitimacy
* Review current product detections to ensure they are performing to the company standard
* Address internal questions and concerns regarding customer threat detections

 **What You'll Need:**

* Exposure and understanding of different types and functionality of malware
* Experience with reverse engineering malware, or malware operations
* Knowledge of programming and scripting languages, in particular Python
* Fundamental understanding of attributes of binary files such as imports/exports and packers
* Ability to demonstrate practical knowledge of research/collection skills and analytical methods
* General understanding of threat/risk management and threat/risk assessment
* Familiarity with various operating systems
* Ability to break down complex problems into workable components
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

* Experience in a security operations center or similar environment responding to incidents
* A thorough understanding of Windows OS internals and the Windows API
* Knowledge of MacOS and/or Linux
* Familiarity with tools used in targeted and criminal cyber\-intrusions
* A background in exploit and vulnerability analysis

As an Animal Cruelty Intelligence Analyst, you’ll help uncover the people, relationships, patterns, and networks behind organized animal fighting and other serious cruelty cases, turning scattered pieces of information into intelligence that can help advance investigations and support enforcement action.

  



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging beneath the surface, connecting the dots, and finding meaning in information others may overlook. Your work will directly support investigators, attorneys, and law enforcement partners and help strengthen a more proactive, intelligence\-led approach to combating animal cruelty.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Contract (~30 hours/week)
jobs.description:
**About Haven Energy**
======================



At Haven Energy, we're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of clean energy technologies by helping homeowners install solar and battery systems. We specialize in deploying battery systems to build VPPs through strategic partnerships with utilities, non\-profits, and government agencies, with a particular focus on low and moderate income households. As a growing startup, we're looking for dynamic, driven professionals who want to make a real impact in the clean energy space.


**Summary of Role**
-------------------



Haven is looking for a contract analyst to do hands\-on analytical work across the business, with an expected emphasis on our marketing and sales funnel.



You’ll be looking at where leads come from, where they stall, which channels and campaigns produce installs rather than just form fills, and what our real cost per acquisition looks like given a long, multi\-step sales cycle. But the role isn't limited to it. We're a small team with a lot of open questions. Priorities may shift into operations, installation throughput, program performance, or wherever the most valuable question happens to be that month.



Across all of it, the common thread is the same: when the answer depends on how something is counted (e.g. what a "qualified lead" is, when a deal is really attributable to a channel, what counts as a completed install) you'll work out a defensible definition, document it, implement it in the data, and explain the reasoning in plain language.



You'll work on top of our existing stack (Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt) rather than building infrastructure. AI tooling handles much of the routine pipeline work, and our software engineers are available for harder infrastructure problems. What we need from you is analytical judgment and the ability to communicate what you find to a non\-technical audience.



This is a remote contract engagement at roughly 30 hours per week. Compensation depends on experience.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Analyze the conversion funnel**


* Map how leads move from first touch through qualification, sale, and install
* Write documentation on current implementations and proposals for new analytics approaches
* Analyze conversion rates by channel, campaign, geography, program, and customer segment
* Evaluate channel and campaign performance against downstream outcomes (installs, revenue), not just top\-of\-funnel volume
* Work out CAC and payback by channel in a way that holds up given our sales cycle and partner\-driven programs


**Take on analysis wherever it's most needed**


* Dig into questions from across the business including, installation throughput, program and partner performance, customer outcomes
* Investigate specific questions as they come up, and surface things nobody thought to ask about
* Bring a recommendation, not just a chart


**Pin down how things get counted**


* Turn fuzzy questions ("is this channel working?") into precise, well\-scoped metrics
* Where teams count the same thing differently, work with them to land on one clear definition then document it and implement it in our models
* Build the logic into dbt so the numbers are reproducible rather than living in an ad\-hoc spreadsheet


**Make the findings usable**


* Build and maintain the dashboards the team relies on
* Present findings clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Leave your work documented well enough that the team can keep using it after the engagement


**Improve what we capture**


* Flag gaps in how we track leads, sources, and funnel stages in HubSpot, and recommend fixes so the data supports the analysis we want to do


**You're a Great Fit If You Have**
----------------------------------


* 4\+ years in analytics, data analysis, or a hybrid data role
* Real depth on marketing and sales funnels: you've built funnel models, worked through attribution tradeoffs, and can explain why you chose one approach over another
* Professional, hands\-on experience with SQL. You can get to the answer yourself and verify it in the data rather than hand\-waving the logic underneath it
* Comfort in a modern data stack. dbt and Git experience required
* Range: you're comfortable being pointed at an unfamiliar part of the business and figuring out the right question
* Strong written and verbal communication, and a talent for explaining data to non\-technical audiences
* Experience with CRM data, especially HubSpot
* A bias toward getting to a useful answer quickly and iterating, rather than waiting for perfectly clean inputs
* The ability to scope your own work: you'll get context and priorities from us, but not tickets
* Experience using AI/LLM tooling (e.g., Claude Code) for analytics work

**Bonus**
---------


* Experience with long or multi\-step consumer sales cycles (home improvement, solar, insurance, finance, healthcare)
* Operations or supply chain analytics experience
* Interest in how energy is produced and consumed

**This Role May Not Be Right For You If**
-----------------------------------------


* You want requirements handed to you as tickets
* You're looking for a marketing execution role. This is analysis, not running campaigns
* You're looking for a data\-engineering engagement
* You'd rather stay heads\-down in the warehouse than talk to stakeholders about what they need
* You want a stable, narrowly\-defined scope

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------



Haven embraces diversity and is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Engagement decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description \& Responsibilities:

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence\-based decisions.  

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience. **Position Responsibilities*** Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source\-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support
* Partner with leaders and subject\-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures
* Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained
* Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation
* Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self\-service analytics across the organization
* Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate
* Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic
* Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi\-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star\-schema principles
* Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage
* Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant
* Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root\-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams
* Translate open\-ended questions into measurable definitions, source\-to\-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary
* Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self\-service datasets
* Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone
* Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component\-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3\.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components
* Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural\-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data

* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance\-aware analysis
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row\-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued
* Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources
* Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source\-to\-target mapping
* Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work
* Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls
* Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence
* Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance

**Relevant certifications or credentials, such as:*** Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\)
* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\)

* Tableau Desktop Specialist certification
* Experience operating in a regulated, security\-sensitive, government, or defense\-adjacent environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools

jobs.title: Accounting and Finance Operations Analyst (Copy)
jobs.description:
New York
Finance \& Accounting
In office
Full\-time
**What is Bilt?**
Bilt is the membership for where you live.  

  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.
Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.  

  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.  

  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.
**What's the role?**
Bilt's Finance team is growing, and we're looking for a **Accounting and Finance Operations Analyst** to own the day\-to\-day engine of our finance and accounting operations. Reporting directly to the Controller, you'll run end\-to\-end OPEX operations — accounts payable, corporate card management, reimbursements — while building and optimizing the systems and workflows that power it all. You'll also be the go\-to finance partner for every team at Bilt when it comes to expenses, vendor management, and spend analysis.  

  

This is a high\-touch, cross\-functional role on a 9\-person Finance team. You'll dig into OPEX data across software, marketing, T\&E, and payroll to surface insights that drive smarter cost management. If you're hungry to learn, thrive on building processes from the ground up, and want to be where financial decisions are made — this is it.  

  

**In this role, you will...**
* Own end\-to\-end OPEX operations, including accounts payable, corporate card, and reimbursement review and approval
* Drive the build\-out and continuous optimization of core finance and accounting workflows and systems, including Ramp and internal data infrastructure
* Deliver in\-depth analysis across key OPEX categories — including software, marketing, T\&E, and payroll — to surface insights and support cost management
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to lead vendor management efforts, including spend analysis, OPEX\-focused contract review, and coordinating vendor additions/terminations
* Serve as the primary finance point of contact for expense\-related inquiries across all teams
* Manage and maintain the company's corporate card program, ensuring policy compliance and timely reconciliation
* Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy in AP and reimbursement workflows
* Support month\-end close activities related to OPEX accruals and reconciliations
  

  

**In terms of qualifications, we're seeking:**
**Must Have:**
* 1\-2\+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or a related field
* Foundational accounting knowledge — solid understanding of debits, credits, and core accounting principles
* Strong work ethic and willingness to roll up your sleeves in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills and high emotional intelligence — you'll work with every team at Bilt
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills
* Proficiency with or ability to quickly learn financial tools and platforms (Ramp, banking platforms)
  

  

**Nice to Have:**
* Experience working at a startup or high\-growth company
* Hands\-on experience with Ramp or similar AP/expense management platforms
* Prior experience in accounts payable, expense management, or financial operations
  

  

**Benefits**
* **Compensation** — We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program
* **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** — Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We've got you and your family covered from day one.
* **401k plan with a match** — Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we're here to help you get there.
* **Commuter FSAs** — We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don't think getting there should be so expensive.
* **UNLIMITED PTO** — Because we believe that working hard shouldn't mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.
* **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** — We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.
  

  

At Bilt, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt's salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.  

  

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.  

  

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes — should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.  

  

The salary range for a **Accounting and Finance Operations Analyst** is **$80,000\-$100,000** and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Program Manager leads the planning, development, and launch of technology\-enabled programs and enhancements for the Loyalty Operations organization. Partnering with business stakeholders, this role prioritizes projects, writes clear business requirements, and bridges the gap between business needs and technical delivery. The Program Manager owns end\-to\-end program development from ideation through launch, working with cross\-functional teams — including Information Technology — to deliver initiatives on schedule. Success in the role means breaking complex problems into simple, well\-documented steps and designing capabilities that close competitive gaps, grow revenue, and strengthen our value proposition to guests. This is an individual contributor position reporting to the Director, Loyalty Operations, with no direct reports and indirect management of internal technology resources.

***Note: This role is 4 days onsite based in North Bethesda, MD or Scottsdale, AZ. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.***

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead planning and implementation of loyalty programs, incorporating stakeholder requirements, market and competitive knowledge, and current system capabilities
* Write sound business requirements grounded in business strategy and internal system capabilities.
* Own and execute program enhancements from ideation to launch, including requirements gathering, cross\-functional alignment, competitive research, scrum participation, user testing, launch, and adoption.
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact, accounting for functional and resource dependencies.
* Set and track project schedules, provide resource usage and status updates, and report risks, issues, action items, and decisions
* Communicate project roadmaps, key milestones, specifications, value proposition, training tools, and competitive information to stakeholders on a regular reporting cycle.
* Lead user acceptance testing for assigned projects.
* Manage programs post\-launch, evaluating performance and customer insights to identify future enhancement needs. Serve as the subject matter expert and primary operations business contact for all programs and projects managed.

The Technical Project Manager (TPM) is the hands\-on project leader for assigned data center commissioning, startup, and service projects. * Coordinate quality requirements, punch\-list completion, turnover documentation, customer acceptance, lessons learned, and formal closeout.

The Project Coordinator / Program Engineer is a key member of the PMO, responsible for ensuring disciplined program execution and transparency across a multi–Task Order software\-development IDIQ. This role owns management CDRLs, program data integrity, PMO portal dashboards, risk/issue/action tracking, IDIQ schedule visibility, and supports stakeholder communication and process/tool improvement to enable efficient, high‑quality delivery. In this role, you will:


* **Program Data, Analysis, and Reporting**


	+ Collect, validate, and analyze program data across all task orders (schedule, cost, risks, issues, staffing, quality metrics).
	+ Produce regular internal reports and dashboards for the PMO and program leadership that:
	
	
		- Highlight status against key milestones and deliverables.
		- Surface trends, risks, and variances.
	+ Support ad‑hoc data calls (internal and customer) with accurate, timely information.
* **CDRL Creation, Maintenance, and Compliance**


	+ Maintain the master inventory of all CDRLs for the IDIQ and each task order (formats, due dates, owners, approval workflows).
	+ Draft or coordinate creation of CDRLs in accordance with contract requirements and customer templates/standards.
	+ Track CDRL status end‑to‑end:
	
	
		- Assignment to owners.
		- Development, review, and approval.
		- On‑time submission to the customer.
	+ Monitor quality and completeness of CDRLs; ensure they align with contractual expectations and program messaging.
	+ Maintain historical CDRL records and version control for auditability and reuse.
* **PMO Portal Dashboard Ownership**


	+ Own the design, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of the PMO portal/dashboard (e.g., SharePoint, Power BI, or similar).
	+ Consolidate data from multiple sources (schedules, finance, risks, quality, staffing) into a clear, consumable dashboard for:
	
	
		- PMO leadership.
		- Program managers and task order leads.
		- Technical and quality leads.
	+ Ensure the dashboard provides:
	
	
		- Near‑real‑time visibility into program health.
		- Drill‑downs by task order, release, or capability where feasible.
	+ Partner with PMO stakeholders to refine dashboard content, visuals, and filters so they support decision‑making and early risk detection.
	+ Maintain access controls, data refresh processes, and documentation for the portal.
* **Risk, Issue, and Action Item Coordination**


	+ Help maintain the program risk/issue/action register:
	
	
		- Log new risks/issues from meetings and reviews.
		- Track mitigation actions, owners, and due dates.
	+ Provide regular status updates on items that may affect schedule, quality, or contractual deliverables.
	+ Support preparation of risk and issue narratives for program reviews and customer meetings.
* **Schedule and Deliverable Tracking Support**


	+ Support creation and maintenance of integrated program schedules and deliverable trackers.
	+ Monitor key milestones and dependencies; flag slippage or risk to the Program Manager/Deputy PM.
	+ Ensure deliverable and CDRL calendars are aligned with the master schedule and communicated to responsible owners.
* **Meeting Support and Stakeholder Communication**


	+ Support PMO and program‑level meetings by:
	
	
		- Preparing agendas, decks, dashboards, and data views.
		- Capturing minutes, decisions, and action items.
	+ Ensure follow‑through on actions by tracking owners and due dates and updating the PMO dashboard accordingly.
	+ Help standardize reporting templates and communication formats used across task orders.
* **Process and Tool Improvement**


	+ Identify opportunities to streamline data collection, reporting, and CDRL workflows (e.g., automation, standard templates, improved processes).
	+ Partner with technical, quality, and agile leads to align tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence, SharePoint, BI tools) with reporting needs.
	+ Document and maintain “how‑to” guidance for PMO tools and dashboards to support consistency and onboarding.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
* TS/SCI with Polygraph
* 3\+ years of experience in a fast‑paced Agile development environment
* 8\+ years of experience in project coordination, program analysis, or engineering support within a PMO or multi project environment; government/IDIQ experience preferred.
* Familiarity with:


	+ CDRL management and contract reporting.
	+ Schedule and milestone tracking

jobs.title: (735) Counterintelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Summary**



Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value\-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end\-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.

**Position Description:**  

  

The Counterintelligence Analyst will support the NOAA Research Security Program by conducting specialized analyses to identify, assess, and mitigate threats to NOAA's critical technologies, intellectual property, and research data. This position requires a strong background in counterintelligence methodologies with specific experience in research security, technology protection, and foreign influence detection.

  

**Location:** (Hybrid) Silver Spring, MD


**Clearance:** TS/SCI

  

**Responsibilities and/or Success Factors:**

**Threat Assessment and Analysis**


* Conduct comprehensive assessments of foreign influence risks in NOAA research programs
* Analyze intelligence reports and open\-source information to identify potential threats to NOAA\-sponsored research
* Perform due diligence research on foreign entities seeking collaboration with NOAA research programs.
* Support development of the NOAA Critical Assets List by identifying critical technologies vulnerable to foreign acquisition Policy and Procedure Development
* Assist in developing specialized due diligence processes for both classified (JWICS) and unclassified research security reviews
* Contribute to the export control policy development and technology control plan assessments
* Draft standard operating procedures for counterintelligence\-focused due diligence in research collaborations
* Support development of disclosure requirements standards and consequences for violations Security Framework Implementation
* Provide counterintelligence expertise for gap analysis of current NOAA research security posture
* Contribute to risk assessments of critical and emerging technologies as defined by NSPM\-33
* Develop procedures for identifying and mitigating nation\-state threats to NOAA research
* Assist in designing supply chain risk management processes to protect research integrity Training and Incident Response
* Develop specialized training materials focusing on foreign influence detection, technology protection, and threat awareness
* Support tabletop exercises and simulations specific to counterintelligence scenarios
* Contribute to incident response planning for cases of suspected foreign influence or unauthorized technology transfer
* Provide briefings to NOAA personnel on counterintelligence trends and threat indicators
  


**Minimum Qualifications Including Certificates:**


* Bachelor's degree in Intelligence Studies, International Relations, Cybersecurity, or related field
* Minimum 5 years of experience in counterintelligence, preferably in a government or research environment.
* In\-depth knowledge of NSPM\-33 requirements and research security frameworks
* Experience with export control regulations (ITAR, EAR) and technology control procedures.
* Proficiency with classified and unclassified intelligence analysis tools and methodologies.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to synthesize information from multiple sources.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  


**Security Requirement:**


* Active **Top Secret Clearance (SSBI/Tier 5\) required** prior to start.
* Must comply with DoD/NISPOM regulations and NOAA security requirements.

 **AAP Statement**



We are proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, we evaluate qualified candidates in full consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, and any other protected status.

Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, Mid**The Opportunity:**  

As a cyber threat intelligence (CTI) analyst, you know how to support a Security Operations Center (SOC) by collecting, analyzing, and correlating CTI from a wide range of open‑source, commercial, government, and industry partners. This role manages and operationalizes ThreatConnect to enrich SOC investigations, identify emerging threats, and maintain high‑quality intelligence workflows. The analyst develops and disseminates actionable intelligence products such as reports, alerts, and briefings, to inform SOC operations, leadership, and mission stakeholders. The position also facilitates intelligence sharing and collaboration across interagency and cross‑industry communities such as ISACs and AIS, ensuring timely exchange of relevant threat information. Additionally, the analyst contributes to the maturity of the CTI program by conducting annual capability assessments, identifying gaps, and developing strategic roadmaps to enhance intelligence processes, tooling, and integration with SOC operations.  

  

Cyber threats are evolving. Booz Allen is committed to creating an environment where you not only keep pace with the industry, but propel it forward. With access to academic programs, certifications, and opportunities to use expert tradecraft, we’ll continuously invest in you so you can create the career you want as you grow.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

* 2\+ years of experience in CTI, SOC support, or incident response, including intelligence analysis or threat research
* Experience collecting, analyzing, and correlating intelligence from open and closed sources, including government, commercial, and industry feeds

* Experience with intelligence sharing frameworks and communities, including ISACs, AIS, or federal information‑sharing programs
* Knowledge of cyber threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK
* Ability to develop actionable intelligence products such as reports, alerts, and briefings, for technical and non‑technical audiences
* Ability to brief leadership and produce high‑quality analytic products
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements
* Bachelor’s degree

* Possession of strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Financial Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Critical decisions are made every single day in our government. What if you could use your skills to help them make informed decisions? With all the information available today, it takes a skilled analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. As a Finan cia l Intelligence Analyst, you’ll use your spe cia lized technical and functional experience and your attention to detail to develop insights, understanding, recommendations, and reports to give your client the actionable information and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem\-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our nation's leaders.


As a Finan cia l Intelligence Analyst on our team, you will leverage your understanding of international money laundering, threat finance, sanctions evasion, corruption and kleptocracy, and other illicit finance typologies to guide our clients’ investigations, analysis, enforcement efforts, or partnership e nga gements. You will evaluate finan cia l data to identify and analyze indicators of money laundering activity. To develop deep finan cia l intelligence insights, you will explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources, including intelligence reporting, open\-source information, regulatory filings, finan cia l tra nsa ction data, and blockchain tra nsa ction tracing. You will validate information to support evidentiary and analytical standards and write assessments for presentation to regulators and senior policy makers. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile\-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.



Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility \& Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user\-to\-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine\-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real\-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.


**About the Role:**
-------------------



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.



The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision\-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter\-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


### **Business, Product \& Security Analytics**


* Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
* Analyze and contextualize:
* + business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
	+ mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
	+ security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.
* Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
* Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
* Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Data \& Reporting**


* Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3\.
* Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
* Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
* Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------


### **Required**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or a related environment.
* Expert\-level SQL proficiency and experience working with complex relational datasets.
* Experience with AWS Athena or a similar cloud\-based analytical query engine.
* Advanced Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
* Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data.
* Experience working with large\-scale datasets in cloud environments.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal supervision.

### **Preferred**


* Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, data exploration, and automation.
* Experience in cybersecurity, mobile applications, and/or SaaS.
* Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools and workflows for automating reporting and analysis.

**Success in This Role:**
-------------------------



Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytics partner across the organization. The Senior Data Analyst will deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights; proactively identify opportunities for improvement; and continuously enhance the company's reporting and analytical capabilities.  

  

This posting is for an existing vacancy. We are actively recruiting to fill this position immediately.

jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Join **Peraton** in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the **FAA’s** **Enterprise Network Service (FENS)** program. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton delivers the mission\-critical systems and services that keep millions of passengers and aircraft moving safely every day.

  

We’re looking for forward\-thinking professionals who thrive in complex, high\-impact environments and want their work to matter. *

jobs.title: Program Manager - FAA Compliance
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.


This position is looking for a highly motivated Program Manager with emphasis in FAA, DoD, and other regulatory organizations focused on FAA compliance and airspace access. Work closely with the program leadership, legal and a wide spectrum of cross\-departments you will lead and support efforts focused on enabling the team to move fast and changing the industry forever. The role will be responsible for executing, and managing all FAA compliance and airspace authorization efforts for the Test \& Evaluation team. Regulatory approval is frequently the pacing item for a test campaign, and this role owns clearing it.
  

  

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all sub\-surface, surface, airborne operation and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub\-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Develop, implement, and maintain compliance programs to ensure adherence to FAA regulations, including Part 21, Part 91, Part 107, Part 135, or other applicable rules.
* Prepare and submit regulatory applications, including FAA Certificates of Authorization (COAs) — new, amended, and altitude/airspace expansions — 44807 exemptions, Part 107 waivers and authorizations, Certificates of Waiver, and type certification requests.
* Own the intake, prioritization, and end\-to\-end tracking of airspace access requests from across the company, maintaining a single authoritative system of record from initial request through FAA decision and post\-approval conditions.
* Serve as a liaison with the FAA, Department of Defense (DoD), and other regulatory bodies to obtain necessary approvals for flight operations and experimental testing.
* Coordinate the non\-FAA approvals that also gate flight test — including radio frequency and spectrum authorizations — so that airspace and supporting authorizations arrive in step rather than sequentially.
* Develop compliance strategies for new technologies, including autonomous systems, beyond visual line\-of\-sight (BVLOS) operations, and large UAS.
* Build and maintain the team's compliance reporting: track submission volume, approval and denial turnaround, cycle time, and aging of open requests; deliver a recurring readout to program and company leadership on regulatory throughput, bottlenecks, and risk.
* Support test site and range activation — work with site leads and flight operations on airspace design, deconfliction, NOTAMs, operating limitations, and standing authorizations for recurring test activity.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of FAA regulatory changes and provide guidance to internal stakeholders on compliance implications.
* Support audits, inspections, and internal reviews to ensure ongoing regulatory adherence.
* Work closely with engineering, flight operations, and safety teams to integrate compliance requirements into operational procedures.
* Assist in developing and maintaining regulatory documentation, manuals, and training materials related to FAA compliance.
* Provide training and guidance to company personnel on FAA compliance matters.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Aerospace Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in FAA regulatory compliance, certification, airworthiness or equivalent experience.
* Strong knowledge of FAA regulatory frameworks, including experience with COAs, 44807 exemptions, Part 91, Part 135, or Part 107 operations.
* Experience engaging directly with FAA representatives and regulatory agencies.
* Ability to instrument and report on your own process: define the metrics that show whether approvals are keeping pace with test demand, and present them to a leadership audience.
* Familiarity with autonomous systems, UAS, and emerging aviation technologies.
* Experience in defense\-related aviation programs, including interactions with the DoD or other government agencies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements to real\-world operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience drafting regulatory submissions and compliance documentation.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced environment, balancing regulatory requirements with operational objectives.
* Strong organizational, leadership, and project management skills.
* Must have strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

* Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly; apply them accurately; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and, determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems.

jobs.description:
**Field Project Manager, Fire Systems**
---------------------------------------


Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, and this role supports the delivery of fire systems projects that help protect people, property, and operations. You will join a collaborative environment focused on safety, customer impact, and professional growth, with the support needed to deliver strong project outcomes.


We value practical problem\-solving, teamwork, and a culture where your ideas and experience help shape successful execution in the field.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Field Project Manager, Fire Systems leads moderately complex fire protection and security projects with medium to high corporate priority. In this role, you will guide projects from planning through closeout, balancing schedule, cost, safety, quality, and customer expectations while serving as a key point of contact for internal teams, customers, vendors, and project partners.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead moderately complex projects and provide project management support in scope definition, risk identification, resource allocation, and facilitation.
* Set up local project offices as needed and maintain control of schedule, cost, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Share project updates, project cycle status, and expected outcomes with management and customers.
* Manage vendor relationships throughout installation to support smooth project execution.
* Oversee project progression from inception to completion, including design, permits, material delivery, labor schedules, and field installation.
* Develop project plans that support schedule and budget targets, and conduct Work in Progress meetings.

**How You Will Do It**

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile\-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.



Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility \& Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user\-to\-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine\-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real\-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.


**About the Role:**
-------------------



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.



The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision\-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter\-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.


**What You'll Do:**
